items.question: What app development services does DIGITECH offer?
items.answer: DIGITECH offers end-to-end mobile app development including native iOS (Swift), native Android (Kotlin), and cross-platform apps using React Native and Flutter. We handle everything from concept, UX/UI design and development through to App Store and Play Store deployment.

items.question: Do you develop native iOS applications?
items.answer: Yes — we build native iOS applications using Swift that fully conform to Apple's Human Interface Guidelines. Our iOS team ensures your app performs flawlessly across all iPhone and iPad devices with a polished, App Store-ready experience.

items.question: What CRM development services does DIGITECH provide?
items.answer: We build fully custom CRM systems tailored to your business workflows, including lead management, pipeline automation, third-party integrations (email, calendar, ERP), analytics dashboards, role-based access, and mobile-ready interfaces.

items.question: What web development services does DIGITECH offer?
items.answer: We cover the full spectrum — frontend development with React and Next.js, full-stack applications, headless CMS integration, e-commerce solutions, landing pages, progressive web apps, and complete website redesigns. Every project is built with performance, SEO and accessibility in mind.

items.question: Can DIGITECH build a startup MVP quickly?
items.answer: Absolutely. We specialise in rapid MVP development for startups — helping you ship a functional, investor-ready product in weeks rather than months. Our process focuses on the core value proposition first so you can validate your idea and iterate fast.

items.question: Does DIGITECH offer digital marketing services?
items.answer: Yes. Alongside development, we provide SEO, social media marketing, content strategy, Google Ads and performance analytics. Our integrated approach means your website and marketing campaigns work together as a single growth engine.

items.question: How does your project development process work?
items.answer: We follow a five-step process: Discovery (understanding your goals), Strategy (planning architecture and design direction), Design (wireframes and visual design with your approval), Development (agile build cycles with regular updates), and Launch & Support (deployment, QA and ongoing maintenance).

items.question: What is your typical project timeline and pricing?
items.answer: Timelines vary by scope — a landing page can launch in 1–2 weeks, a full web application typically takes 6–12 weeks, and a mobile app 8–16 weeks. Pricing is project-based. We provide a detailed proposal after an initial discovery call so there are no surprises.
